title: Jonah and the Lantern
author: Zephyrine Winterbourne
blurb: Freya Halloran, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
